scripts.format: prettier --write package.json src cypress cypress.config.ts index.html tsconfig.json eslint.config.js vite.config.js vitest.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json src cypress cypress.config.ts index.html tsconfig.json eslint.config.js vite.config.js vitest.config.ts pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.prepare:e2e: cd ../platform-api && php -r "file_put_contents('database/e2e.sqlite', '');" && APP_ENV=local DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=database/e2e.sqlite SESSION_DRIVER=file TOGGLEFLOW_DEMO_ENABLED=true php artisan migrate:fresh --force --seed
scripts.serve:api:e2e: cd ../platform-api && APP_NAME=ToggleFlow APP_ENV=local DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_DATABASE=database/e2e.sqlite SESSION_COOKIE=toggleflow-session SESSION_DRIVER=file TOGGLEFLOW_DEMO_ENABLED=true php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm prepare:e2e && start-test "pnpm serve:api:e2e" http://127.0.0.1:8000/up "pnpm serve:dashboard:e2e" http://127.0.0.1:5173 "pnpm cypress:run"
